symptom: The selective opening guard that passed the 3 seed high-pressure no-regression probe did not scale to a 10 seed caramel-workshop target follow-up. Against the per-map edge branch plus all-map late filter baseline, both baseline and candidate recorded 0.1 win rate, but the candidate average survival dropped from 242.8409s to 238.65s. The fixed-window validator reported policy_window_regression_failed with a 300s/caramel-workshop survival blocker of -4.1909s.
root_cause: The repair is currently seed-local rather than broadly robust. The candidate converts seed 63402 from player_health_depleted at 245.2901s to duration_reached at 300.0150s, but it loses baseline's previous seed 63407 victory, dropping that seed from duration_reached at 300.0150s to player_health_depleted at 231.0204s. This indicates the terminal-sequence checkpoint and selective opening guard shift the winning trajectory between seeds instead of improving the target distribution.
fix: Do not promote the selective opening guard beyond repair evidence. Before expanding to a larger matrix, compare the seed 63402 success trace with the new seed 63407 failure trace, add a seed/state retention guard for baseline-winning terminal paths, and require 10 seed caramel target no-regression before any further high-pressure follow-up.
validation: Ran baseline_caramel_300s_10seed.json and candidate_caramel_300s_10seed.json for caramel-workshop seeds 63400-63409 at 300s. After adding single-map report support to validate_policy_window_regression.py, reran window_regression_caramel_300s_10seed.json and recorded decision policy_window_regression_failed with one survival blocker. Reran the candidate with --trace-failed-only and saved 9 failed seed traces under candidate_failed_traces/.
